# Which event deal pays your coffee cart the most?

> Free calculator for mobile coffee cart owners: compare a booking fee, a percentage of sales and a prepaid drink guarantee for an event, with break-even drinks and net per hour. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
